instruction: Software launch locations: FreeCAD: `/usr/bin/freecad`; LibreCAD: `/usr/bin/librecad`; KiCad: `/home/user/Applications/kicad-10.0.2/kicad-10.0.2-x86_64.AppImage`. Choose the appropriate tool from FreeCAD, LibreCAD, and KiCad, available in the current Ubuntu environment, to complete the task. Open or import /home/user/Desktop/gui18_wall_openings_seed.dxf. Create a 900 mm wide door opening in the wall with opening center x=1200. Create a 1200 mm wide window opening with opening center x=3300. At the door opening, add a door leaf line and a door swing arc. At the window opening, add two window lines on layer WINDOW. Keep the remaining wall segments on layer WALL. Save as /home/user/Desktop/gui18_wall_openings_completed.dxf.
